Name: StarDew Valley ModManager(SDVMM) -not being worked on anymore-
Author: ken28
Description:
_________________________________________

[color=#ff0000]SDVMM is not maintained anymore, if possible dont use it since it may result in errors.
If you are looking for a new Modmanager then try out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4536]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4536[/url][/color]

_________________________________________


As of now it support:

- installing and updating of SMAPI
- Installing,deactivating as well as deleting of Smapi mods
- XNB mods as of now can only be installed and deletet in which case the programm will restore the last version of the file
- it can launch SMAPI,Storm and StarDew itself if wished

Downloading mods doesnt work as of now, it will just link you to the Stardew Valley mod Forum
